ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَأَبْقِنَا بِكَ لَا بِنَا فِيْ جَمِيْعِ اللَّحَظَاتِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, wa abqinā bika lā binā fī jamī`i ‘l-laḥaẓāt.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and let us remain with You not with us in every instant!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَانْشُرْ عَلَيْنَا نِعْمَتَكَ الْمَخْصُوْصَةَ بِأَهْلِ الْعِنَايَاتِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa ‘nshur ‘alaynā ni`mataka ‘l-makhṣūṣata bi ahli ‘l-`ināyāt.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and spread Your special favors upon us by those who care!
